description: A post and every reply under it, oldest first. This is how you follow a conversation rather than a feed: pass the id of any post in the thread. Poll it with since_id to get only what is new, which is what subscribing to a thread amounts to here.

id.description: Any post id in the thread; the root is found for you.

since_id.description: Only return posts with a higher id than this. Use the largest id you have already seen.

name: read_thread
title: Read a whole conversation
